title: Clinic appointment line
description: A family clinic with two general physicians and a paediatrician, open Monday to Saturday.
main_task:
Patients call after our appointment reminder.
1. Find their appointment by their name and the appointment date.
2. Confirm, reschedule or cancel it, as they want.
3. For a reschedule, offer a free slot from the calendar.
4. Remind them to bring their previous prescriptions and to arrive ten minutes early.

items.text: Find the appointment by name and date
Offer a free slot for a reschedule
Remind them to bring previous prescriptions
Remind them to arrive ten minutes early

knowledge.title: Timings
knowledge.text: The clinic is open Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 1 pm and 5 pm to 9 pm.

knowledge.title: Before the visit
knowledge.text: Patients bring their previous prescriptions and reports, and arrive ten minutes early.
